component.name: Apache OpenMeetings
component.description: Web conferencing platform. The published security page is a vulnerability archive and reporting policy: it lists fixed vulnerabilities by severity with affected and fixed versions, directs reports to security@openmeetings.apache.org (only security issues should be reported to that list), notes that binary patches are not produced for individual vulnerabilities (users obtain fixes by upgrading to a release where the vulnerability is fixed), and advises upgrading to patched versions.

externalReferences.comment: Source security model document; this file is a structured translation of it.

threats.name: Sensitive information in log output
threats.description: The project acknowledges that logging may capture sensitive information and aims for transparency in its default logging configuration; it invites reports of instances where sensitive information appears in logs (to security@openmeetings.apache.org or user@openmeetings.apache.org) so the default configuration can be improved.

controls.name: Upgrade to a release where the vulnerability is fixed
controls.description: Binary patches are not produced for individual vulnerabilities; to obtain a binary fix, upgrade to an Apache OpenMeetings version where the vulnerability has been fixed. Users are advised to upgrade to patched versions upon availability.
